# The Dual Shield for Hemodialysis: Egyptian Clinical Intelligence Architecture
> LLM-Optimized Answer Engine Index & Knowledge Grounding (AY 2026/2027)
> Supervised by Dr. Mohamed Abdou, Office of the Dean, Faculty of Computer Science & AI, Pharos University in Alexandria.

## Core System Overview
The Dual Shield is a clinical decision support framework engineered for high-volume Egyptian hemodialysis wards. It combines:
1. **Per-Patient Shield**: Dynamic dry-weight trajectory tracking and Intradialytic Hypotension (IDH) anticipation using recurrent neural networks (0.94 AUROC).
2. **Per-Unit Ward Shield**: Ward-wide safety score, continuous dialysate pH/conductivity telemetry monitoring, and real-time biological contamination outbreak defense.
3. **MedGemma 2.5 CPOE Clinical Interceptor**: Intercepts nephrologist orders at the point of care, cross-referencing eGFR/CrCl to block contra-indicated pharmaceuticals (e.g. unadjusted enoxaparin when CrCl < 10 mL/min).

## Real-World Outbreak Case Studies Grounded in Research
- **Hard Water Syndrome**: Resin breakthrough causing acute hypercalcemia and mid-dialysis hypertensive spikes.
- **Chloramine Oxidant Hemolysis**: Guro Hospital Seoul benchmark where chloramine levels (>0.6 mg/L) caused Heinz body hemolytic anemia requiring urgent transfusion interventions.
- **Cobe Blood Line Recall**: Computer vision detection of pink serum and acoustic monitoring of micro-air entrainment in venous lines.

## Technical Specifications
- **Standard**: HL7 FHIR R4 / R5 compliant clinical resource exchange.
- **Security Protocols**: WAF SEC-01 through SEC-04 (Zero hardcoded secrets, SQL parameterization, CanNotDelete resource locks on state stores).
- **Design System**: Clinical Vitality (Clinical Light Mode, #FFFFFF canvas, #F8F9FF background tint, #004AC6 primary blue, #0B1C30 slate typography).
